summary: Set AI approval gates, assess risk, and document oversight with practical decision tools. Explore the five-day AI ethics training course.
lede: AI ethics training for decision-makers covers governance of AI proposals before and after approval. Product owners, risk leaders, and procurement executives practise scoping impacts, reviewing fairness evidence, assigning risk ownership, and defining human oversight. They also develop supplier-assurance questions, escalation workflows, decision records, and monitoring plans; the course focuses on governance rather than building or technically auditing AI models.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who approve, procure, govern, or oversee AI use cases and need to make decisions they can explain and record.
modules: AI Governance Reporting with NIST AI RMF
prerequisites: Experience reviewing, sponsoring, procuring, or overseeing AI-enabled proposals or operational decisions is recommended. No coding or model-building experience is required.
topics: Legal risk for AI, data and digital services
